text: Facing her on the bank blazed the fire, which at once sent a ruddy glare into the room where she was, and overpowered the candles. “Well done, Charley!” said Captain Vye from the chimney-corner. “But I hope it is not my wood that he’s burning.... Ah, it was this time last year that I met with that man Venn, bringing home Thomasin Yeobright—to be sure it was! Well, who would have thought that girl’s troubles would have ended so well? What a snipe you were in that matter, Eustacia!
